title: Adventures in Tech with Alana Karen: Interactive Workshop
desc: Join [Women Impact Tech](https://www.womenimpacttech.com/) and [Alana Karen](https://www.alanakaren.com/), former Google leader and author of [The Adventures of Women in Tech](https://www.alanakaren.com/books), for an interactive workshop exploring career growth, navigating change, and communicating your value in today's evolving tech landscape. 💜Free | Virtual | Open to All
